$description: Source of truth for the seeds.hues.flowers design tokens (SPEC tranche-2 §2, item 2.1). Design Tokens Community Group format (2025.10): an object with $value is a token, other objects are groups. The @theme block in v2/app/globals.css is kept in exact sync with this file; v2/tests/unit/tranche-2-1-tokens.test.ts fails if any name or value differs. Consolidation is value-preserving: every value below is the value the site already renders.

color.$description: Reference palette. Transcribed unchanged from @theme (audit: zero drift; do not disturb).

ink.$description: Body text. 12.7:1 on paper, 14.0:1 on surface.

ink-soft.$description: Secondary text. 8.6:1 on paper, 7.7:1 on paper-deep.

muted.$description: Muted text. 5.6:1 on paper, 6.2:1 on surface, 5.0:1 on paper-deep.

line-strong.$description: UI component boundaries. WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 floor (Ada 2026-11-19, shipped Tranche 1.3).

leaf.$description: Leaf-deep: primary, active tab. 9.4:1 on paper; white on it 10.6:1.

leaf-600.$description: Hover and secondary green. White on it 6.3:1.

link.$description: Body links. 7.0:1 on paper, 7.8:1 on surface, 6.3:1 on paper-deep.

danger.$description: Admin-only destructive verb. White on it 8.93:1.

focus.$description: Warm umber focus ring. 7.4:1 on paper, 8.2:1 on surface.

listing-border.$description: The Quiet Ledger listing card's own hairline. Promoted, never snapped to line (#E0D5B8): Delta E 3.5 apart, a visible difference.

visit-fill.$description: Visit shop pill fill. Promoted, never snapped to leaf-50 (#E3EAD8). Leaf text on it 8.46:1.

stem-rule.$description: Listing stem-rule hairline. Frozen: 151/134/95 is the retired line-strong RGB, kept deliberately. Do not re-derive from color.line-strong.

radius.$description: System radius scale. Every value is the value rendered today; two spellings of one value collapse to one utility.

card.$description: Cards, art frames, sheets (all corners), page alert cards, listing cards, admin rail. Utility rounded-card.

search.$description: SearchBox input and autocomplete panel only. A one-control language, kept as its own step on purpose. Utility rounded-search.

control.$description: Buttons, menus and dropdown panels, admin master-list rows, choice-group cards, error summary boxes. Utility rounded-control.

field.$description: Form fields, small notice and status boxes, TrendBars track. Utility rounded-field.

inner.$description: Inner image frames, skeleton blocks, code blocks. Utility rounded-inner.

bar.$description: TrendBars bars; the :focus-visible ring corner rounding. Utility rounded-bar.

marker.$description: Duplicate-review shape markers only. 3px and 4px are different rendered values and stay different tokens. Utility rounded-marker.

full.$description: Chips, badges, pills, dots, .btn-pill. Documents the pill geometry; consumed via Tailwind's built-in rounded-full (calc(infinity * 1px)), which this file deliberately does not override: defining --radius-full would change every pill's computed radius.

seeds-hues.reason: No @theme variable by design; Tailwind's built-in rounded-full is the rendered value.

packet-inner.$description: .packet::after keyline frame inset radius (18px card radius minus the 5px inset). CSS only, no utility.

shadow.$description: System shadow scale. All values are the rendered values today. Tailwind stock values are tokenized verbatim, never warmed.

card.$description: Standard cards, SearchBox autocomplete panel, AccountPanel alerts list. Utility shadow-card.

listing-raised.$description: Quiet Ledger card, in stock. Frozen: 151/134/95 is the retired line-strong RGB. Do not re-derive. Utility shadow-listing-raised.

listing-flat.$description: Quiet Ledger card, sold out. Frozen RGB rule applies. Utility shadow-listing-flat.

visit-pill.$description: Visit shop pill, in stock only. Recorded as a literal value, not an alias, so a future leaf-600 change cannot silently move it. Utility shadow-visit-pill.

sheet.$description: Admin Sheet (bottom-sheet and centered forms) and the admin seller sort menu. The value the Sheet already renders (shadow-xl), tokenized verbatim. Utility shadow-sheet.

menu.$description: HeaderMenu panel (the one public overlay). The value it already renders (shadow-lg). Utility shadow-menu.

strip-button.$description: FilterStrip chevron buttons. The value they already render (bare shadow). Utility shadow-strip-button.

button-inset.$description: .btn-primary and .btn-danger letterpress edge. CSS only, no utility.

card-image.$description: .card-image sage line. Legacy: removal is Tranche 4 item C8's decision, not this tranche's. CSS only, no utility.

space.$description: Spacing. The on-scale steps document Tailwind's 4px-base scale as the product uses it (no CSS change); the named tokens below them tokenize values that today exist only as arbitrary literals.

seeds-hues.reason: Tailwind's own spacing scale; documented, not emitted.

listing-top.$description: ListingRow and ListingSheetSkeleton card top padding. Utility pt-listing-top.

visit-inline.$description: ListingRow Visit shop pill inline padding. Utility px-visit-inline.

listing-subline.$description: ListingRow location line top margin. Utility mt-listing-subline.

listing-status.$description: ListingRow status line top margin. Utility mt-listing-status.

caption-offset.$description: Variety-view hero caption top margin. Utility mt-caption-offset.

target.$description: House minimum touch target. Utilities min-h-target and min-w-target (defined as @utility rules over this variable, since Tailwind generates no min-h/min-w utility from the size namespace).

admin.$description: Admin shell breakpoint. Variant admin:. 1180px belongs to the iPad band; desktop starts at 1181px.

admin-wide.$description: Admin wide breakpoint (rail width, content max-width). Variant admin-wide:.

visit.$description: Visit shop pill border width. Consumed as border-(length:--border-visit); the length hint is required because a bare border-(--border-visit) resolves to border-color in Tailwind v4.

sans.$value: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
sans.$description: Tool layer: form controls, labels, chips, badges.

serif.$value: var(--font-newsreader), "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, ui-serif, serif

display.$value: var(--font-fraunces), "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, ui-serif, serif

duration-filter-item.$description: Filter-update cascade item duration (listing rows only).

component.$description: Component tokens. Documentation of rendered values; no @theme variables.

admin.$description: Admin card padding pattern: p-4 (16px) stepping to p-5 (20px) at admin:. On-scale; recorded so the density decision exists in the file, not only in copy-pasted classes.

max-width.$description: Admin Sheet centered-form max width. Documented; the class stays the literal admin:max-w-[560px] (a max-width that appears once is documentation, not a utility).

seeds-hues.reason: Single-use layout value; documented, not emitted.
